name: Action Required
description: What the viewer still has to read and acknowledge: everything waiting for them, or the pages of chosen Spaces with Acknowledged or read time. Can show due dates from a due- tag and add tasks each viewer ticks off with Done.

appspaceApis.label: List tagged pages in a Space
appspaceApis.name: getTaggedPages

appspaceApis.label: Get my acknowledgment of a page
appspaceApis.name: getPostAcknowledgment

appspaceApis.label: Read my preferences (where ticked-off tasks are kept)
appspaceApis.name: getPrefs

fields.name: scope
fields.label: What to list
fields.description: Waiting for me: everything the viewer still has to acknowledge, from any Space. Pages of chosen Spaces or topics: the pages of the ones picked below, acknowledged or not.

options.label: Pages of chosen Spaces or topics

fields.name: spaceId
fields.label: Spaces or topics
fields.description: Pages of chosen Spaces: the Spaces or topics whose pages are listed (pick them by name; All Spaces and Current Space do not work here). Waiting for me: optional, only items from these; leave empty or pick All Spaces for every Space.

fields.name: tag
fields.label: Only with this tag
fields.description: Only items with this tag, for example must-read. Leave empty for every item.

fields.name: showCompleted
fields.label: Keep acknowledged pages in the list
fields.description: Acknowledged pages stay and say Acknowledged.

fields.name: tasks
fields.label: Tasks
fields.description: Things every viewer should do once, next to the pages. Each viewer ticks a task off with Done; it then stays off their list. Keep a task's title unchanged once people have ticked it off.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Task
fields.description: For example: Confirm your emergency contact.

fields.name: note
fields.label: Line under it
fields.description: For example: Takes one minute. Leave empty to show the due date.

fields.name: linkUrl
fields.label: Link
fields.description: Optional. Where the task is done: a page, a form or another system.

fields.name: dueDate
fields.label: Due date (YYYY-MM-DD)
fields.description: Optional. Sorts the task among the other items.

fields.name: layout
fields.label: Layout
fields.description: Cards: picture, title and a button per item. List: a quiet list with a line under each title and Done for tasks.

fields.name: maxItems
fields.label: How many
fields.description: Items shown, tasks included (1 to 50). With Show more off and the Cards layout, four are visible at once and the rest scroll.

fields.name: showMore
fields.label: Show more button
fields.description: Shows How many items with a button that opens the rest (up to 50).

fields.name: showReadTime
fields.label: Show read time
fields.description: Worked out from the page's word count.

fields.name: wordsPerMinute
fields.label: Reading speed
fields.description: Words per minute used for the read time.

fields.name: showDueDates
fields.label: Show due dates
fields.description: A page tagged due-2026-10-09 is due on 9 October; items are then sorted by due date.

fields.name: dueTagPrefix
fields.label: Due date tag prefix
fields.description: Change it if your tags use another word.

fields.name: subtitle
fields.label: Line at the top
fields.description: Optional line above the list. Leave blank to show none.

fields.name: buttonLabel
fields.label: Button text
fields.description: The button on each item (Cards), or the line under a page waiting for the viewer (List). Leave blank for the standard wording, which is translated.

fields.name: readLabel
fields.label: Read time text
fields.description: {minutes} becomes the read time. Leave blank for the standard wording, which is translated.

fields.name: dueLabel
fields.label: Due date text
fields.description: {date} becomes the date from the page's due- tag. Leave blank for the standard wording, which is translated.

fields.name: acknowledgedLabel
fields.label: Acknowledged text
fields.description: Shown on a page the viewer has acknowledged. Leave blank for the standard wording, which is translated.

fields.name: emptyText
fields.label: Nothing waiting text
fields.description: Shown when nothing is waiting for the viewer. Leave blank for the standard wording, which is translated.

fields.name: linkTarget
fields.label: Open links in
fields.description: Automatic: Cards open the item in a new tab, List in the same tab. Intranet links open inside the app.

fields.name: acknowledgeUrlTemplate
fields.label: Link address (optional)
fields.description: Where an item opens instead of the standard link. Use {postId}, {origin} and {type}. Leave blank for the standard link.

fields.name: debugMode
fields.label: Diagnostic mode
fields.description: Shows a technical panel under the widget (settings as read, every API call, raw errors) and the editor views of the empty cases. For building and support; turn it off before the page goes live.
